name: diagram-design
description: Editorial diagram design for Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Factory Droid, and Pi. 44 diagram types. Self-contained HTML + SVG. On brand. No Mermaid slop.
one_liner: Teaches an AI coding assistant to draw clean, good-looking diagrams (flowcharts, architecture maps, timelines) that match your brand colors, instead of the ugly default boxes-and-arrows look.
buyer: A technical consultant or agency that bills clients for architecture docs, pitch decks, or onboarding guides and is tired of diagrams looking like unstyled engineering scribbles.
business_use_cases: A freelance technical writer uses it to turn plain system descriptions into client-ready, on-brand architecture diagrams for proposals and documentation.
A startup's founder uses it to quickly produce a clean investor-deck diagram (funnel, roadmap, org chart) without hiring a designer.
A dev agency 'onboards' the skill to a client's brand colors so every diagram it ships in docs and decks already looks like client-approved design work.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a paid 'diagram pack' service for startups: a set of on-brand pitch-deck and architecture diagrams delivered in a day.
Technical writers charge a documentation-design premium by including polished diagrams as a standard deliverable.

steal_this: Offer a $50 same-day gig: take a founder's rough system or roadmap description and turn it into three on-brand diagrams for their deck.
